transport: None. Passive analog NTC thermistor on a 2-conductor lead terminated in a 3.81 mm-pitch plug, into the controller's RTS port. No bus, no address, no baud, no framing, no slave ID — the gateway never talks to this part.

gotchas: This is not a device. It is an accessory to a charge controller and has no protocol of its own. It should not become a DeviceKind entry, and specifically not `environment-sensor` — its reading is the BATTERY's temperature, surfacing as `battery-temperature` on the host `solar-charger`. No new driver, no new dialect map

What fitting it actually changes: input register 0x3110 on the EPEver A/B-series map stops returning the 0xFFFF sentinel and starts returning a real value. `cabin-epever` (xtra.rs, offset 0x10, I16 scale 0.01, sentinel 0xFFFF) already handles both states, so the only observable effect of buying one is that an existing

Two registers, not one, and the two committed protocol revisions disagree on whether the second exists. B-series v2.3 documents BOTH 0x3110 'Battery Temperature' and 0x311B 'Remote battery temperature … measured by remote temperature sensor', °C ×100. A&B-series v2.5 documents 0x3110 only and omits 0x311B entirely. The

Electrical spec is NOT stated in any committed vendor document: NTC nominal resistance, B-value, tolerance, accuracy, and temperature range are all `?`.
